# ChartGallery (chat block)

• ChartGallery(title? (static), types (static), subtitle? (static))
  - Description: A menu of chart types shown as tiles with sample pictures; tapping one sends pick_chart.
  - title: Card title. Defaults to "More chart types".
  - types: Chart types to offer, only those that suit the data (2 to 6).
  - subtitle: Line under the title. Defaults to "Each one is offered only when the data suits it."

ChartGallery(title?, types, subtitle?) — a 2-column menu of chart types, each with a small sample picture and caption: scatter, histogram, heatmap, radar, gauge, waterfall, bar, line, area, donut. Offer only types that suit the user's data (2 to 6). Use it when the user asks what other charts exist or lets you choose. Sends event pick_chart with context {type, name} when a tile is tapped (the others then disable); answer by drawing that type from the user's data. Example: card = ChartGallery(types=["scatter", "histogram", "gauge"])
